item.tib: kha byang shog dril bces par bzung shog dril bcu pa bon stan 'di nyid
item.coloph: gter ston bon zhig gling pas/ yos bu lo zla ba bzhi pas tshes bcu'i nam phyed yol tsam na/ phyug mo dpal ri'i gsang phug rtse nas/ srid pa'i rgyal mos dngos su gtan (bstan) nas gdan drangs so/ shog dril zab mo che ba lnga/ chung ba bcu byung ba/ lo gcig bsgrab pa byas cing nyams su blangs gsang nas/ 'brug lo zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga la/ bla ma'i gdan sa dga' ldan du/ mtha' bzhi drang srong ye shes rang shar gyis bskul nas/ skal ldan du mthong nas/ lung zin rnams 'dzoms nas legs par phab/ dag par gtugs/ gtsang bar rgyud (brgyud)/ dbu zhabs tshang par tshar/ mchod dang bcas pa zin no/ zhang zhung gi dkrug yig mi gcig pa drug las bsgyar ro/ 'di'i don le'u nyi shu tham pa yod pa la/ mthong ba'i grol bkun du (tu) bzang po'i thugs thig dang*/ rigs 'dzin tshe dbang gis (gi) sku tshab rin chen 'od 'bar dang / phyag mtshan mi 'gyur g.yung drung dang gsum/ phyi byang gi bla rdo chen mo'i/ rig 'dzin gyi 'du gnas gsang phug gi dkyil 'og na yod pa longs cig(shig)kha byang ni rim po'i rdza nas 'byung ngo / yang byang ni zur na yod do/ snying byang ni rom po'i rdza nas 'byung ngo / zab rgya sbas rgya gter rgya//
